g.text: PQEC v0.3 Aer: change in guarded-PQEC effect across T1/T2 levels

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Each point is the paired change in (guarded PQEC − reactive) versus the shared baseline; bars are unadjusted 95% bootstrap intervals. * marks global Holm p < 0.05 across all T1/T2 controller and effect-change tests. Negative residual changes favor PQEC; the reference point is zero by definition.
